verbatim_contract: The synthetic and real-architecture experiments validate risk inheritance and spectral denoising, and an intermediate stopping point materially outperforms continued student training.

real_architecture_route.teacher: frozen pretrained ResNet18 with ridge head fit on 1000 labels
real_architecture_route.student: frozen official OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 with SGD linear head
real_architecture_route.comparison: teacher versus W2S student versus direct-label ceiling
real_architecture_route.early_stopping: paired test-set MSE at best checkpoint versus epoch 20

acceptance.W2S: paired bootstrap 95% lower bound for teacher MSE minus best W2S MSE is positive
acceptance.early_stopping: best epoch is before epoch 20 and paired bootstrap 95% lower bound for final MSE minus best MSE is positive
acceptance.control: paired bootstrap 95% lower bound for shuffled-control MSE minus best W2S MSE is positive
acceptance.provenance: all dataset/model hashes, seeds, scale, CPU allocation, and runtime are present

otherwise: BLOCKED, because one substituted experiment cannot falsify the broad empirical claim
